Maximum Age Limit of the driver should be 50 2 Driver should be in proper uniform & have his driving license for at last 5 years 3. Documentary proof of such payment shall have to be enclosed along with the bill of the subsequent month . Service provider will also ensure timely payment of salary to the drivers. 4 The service provider will be solely responsible for the misconduct of the driver. 5. The service provider has to submit documentary evidence in support of its claim of its geographical pres ence in Vadodara City 6. The service Provider shall ensure the availability of adequate petrol/diesel for daily travel and timely re fuelling. 11 The Purchaser will in no way be responsible for violation of traffic rules and /or infringement of any othe r law for the time being in force, either by the driver of the vehicle or by the service provider. The drivers a s well as service provider shall comply with relevant rules and regulations of Motor Vehicles Act and rules a pplicable at present as may be enforced from time to time for which user department will not be liable/res ponsible in any manner whatsoever. Onus of compliance of all the applicable Laws/Acts/Rules including tho se under Motor vehicle Acts/rules shall rest with the service provider only and user/user department will n ot be liable in any manner. 12. The maximum cost celling for midsize operational vehicle should be in accordance with GOI, Ministry o f Finance, and Department of revenue New Delhi's OM F NO. 6/01/2019 IFU/EC-II Dated 11.02.2019 13. Vehicle RC book and documentary evidence in support of number of Kms travelled is required in bid d ocuments to be eligible for participation

14 Vehicle Registration type, Taxi Passing/commercial is preferred and vehicle owner should be the compa ny/Firm. 15. The bidder should not have been debarred or blacklisted by any central/state Govt Or public sector un dertaking/Regulatory authority of India at the time of submission of the bid. 16. Verification of all vehicles at the contract awarding stage will be conducted by this office as per requir ement of bid All vehicles require a valid taxi permit 17 Vendor have to inform the department at least three months in advance about discontinuation of their services, if so. 18 In case of non-requirement, change in Department/Government Policy Services will be discontinued wit hin 15 days of issuance of notice of discontinuance 19. In case of providing dissatisfactory services, services will be discontinued immediately within short not ice of 2 to 5 days 20. Vehicle should not be of before 2024 and having running kilometre not more than 50.000 km. 21 Service provider should have at least three owned taxi passing vehicles having model year not prior to 2024. 22 Service provider will have to submit Certificate of Non-Blacklisting from the Revenue Department (Inco me Tax & GST) 23. Inside vehicles hygienic condition should be maintained, well cleaned (inside and outside), proper seat cover and white towel cover etc. by the Service provider. 24. The upper limit for awarding contract is Rs. 50,000/- per months as per the O.M dated 11.02.2019. .
